author: Decaid Zen
name: Coffee catalog
description: Finds a roaster's shop from the name the user typed, reads its coffee list (Shopify or WooCommerce), and remembers what it learned.

CacheHours.description: How long a roaster's catalog is cached before it is fetched again

SearchApiKey.description: Optional Brave Search API key, used only if the keyless engines fail

q.description: Optional filter; GET returns the known roasters with a catalog

roaster.description: Roaster name in English or Hebrew, or its domain

probe.description: 1 returns only availability and a count, without the list

discover.description: 1 lets a probe fall through to live discovery

site.description: Roaster website or domain to read the catalog from
